# Paola Bramlett: websites, web apps and first apps, designed and built

> Paola Bramlett ("Pao") is a senior product designer with 7+ years of experience who also codes. From Oaxaca, Mexico, she designs, builds and launches websites, web apps and first apps (MVPs) for businesses and founders in any industry, and stays after launch with a hosting and care plan. One person from the idea to the live product, in English or Spanish. AI builders like Lovable and Bolt are a great start; she takes those projects to the finish line.

## Services
- [Website design and development](https://www.paolabramlett.com/services/website-design/): landing pages and business websites for any industry, with SEO and GEO so search engines and AI assistants can find and understand the business. Contact forms, WhatsApp and Stripe payments when needed. Spanish: https://www.paolabramlett.com/es/servicios/disenio-de-sitios-web/
- [Web app design and development](https://www.paolabramlett.com/services/web-app-design-development/): custom web apps such as portals, memberships, bookings or dashboards, from UX to working front-end code. Spanish: https://www.paolabramlett.com/es/servicios/disenio-y-desarrollo-de-web-apps/
- [First app and MVP](https://www.paolabramlett.com/services/first-app-mvp/): for founders and domain experts with an idea; define the MVP, design it (mobile or web) and build it. Spanish: https://www.paolabramlett.com/es/servicios/primera-app-mvp/
- [Finish your AI-built app](https://www.paolabramlett.com/services/finish-your-ai-built-app/): review of an app started in Lovable, Bolt or similar tools, design and code cleanup, and launch. The client keeps everything already built. Spanish: https://www.paolabramlett.com/es/servicios/termina-tu-app-hecha-con-ia/
- Also: design systems in Figma, clickable prototypes, front-end development, hosting and maintenance on Netlify.

## How pricing and timelines work
- No public prices. Every project gets a fixed-price quote after a free call, so the client knows scope, timeline and full investment before starting.
- A landing page or simple prototype: 3–7 days. Full UX/UI design for an app: usually 2–6 weeks. Web apps: timeline defined on the free call.
- Optional annual hosting and care plan on Netlify: hosting, bug fixes and small data changes (like a phone number or opening hours). New content is quoted separately.
- Clients own their code, domain and accounts.

## Process
1. Free call: idea, goals and budget, no commitment.
2. Plan and quote: scope, timeline and fixed price.
3. Design and build: design reviewed and approved, then built, with check-ins.
4. Launch and care: go live, then hosting and care.

## Case studies
- [Genogram tool for therapists](https://www.paolabramlett.com/work/genogram-tool-for-therapists/): a modern canvas that makes a patient's family system readable at a glance; live and used by mental health professionals. Role: UX/UI Designer.
- [Emotional learning app for kids and parents](https://www.paolabramlett.com/work/kids-emotional-learning-app/): games, journaling and check-ins for kids, plus an AI-powered parent view. In development. Role: UX/UI Designer.
- [AI fleet maintenance platform](https://www.paolabramlett.com/work/ai-fleet-maintenance-platform/): quick manual logs plus connected-tool data so AI can flag truck failures early. In development. Role: Senior Product Designer.
- [ExploreTogether](https://www.paolabramlett.com/work/exploretogether/): community travel platform built on trust signals (earlier work).
- [EventFlow](https://www.paolabramlett.com/work/eventflow/): event planning and RSVP platform (earlier work).
- [MindSpace](https://www.paolabramlett.com/work/mindspace/): mental health support concept built around a guided check-in (concept).
Client names are not shared; covers of the first three are concept visualizations because real screens are under NDA.

## Who she works with
Small businesses, personal brands and professionals, founders building a first app, domain experts (therapists, coaches, operators) and teams with a process to digitize. Any industry; past work includes mental health, education, logistics, travel and events. Clients in Mexico, the US, Canada and Europe.
